description:
The Mackenzie 6 Drawer Dresser has six dovetailed drawers with full-extension glides for clothing, bedding, and nursery essentials, in a solid Brown Maple frame.

It measures 56 inches wide, 34 inches high, and 21½ inches deep, and it coordinates with the complete Mackenzie collection.
title: Mackenzie 6 Drawer Dresser
